notes.title: Backer Beta Preview Update
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Friends![/h1]
We're happy to announce that we've updated our previous closed alpha test with LOTS of new content, bug fixes, and platform support ahead of our upcoming closed beta test. This new build contains the first three levels (right about half of the full game!) for both Windows and Mac computers.

[h1]What to Test[/h1]
EVERYTHING! We've done our best to find all the nooks and crannies people can get stuck in, freezes/crashes, and all other sorts of bugs you might encounter in the game, but there are still plenty out there. Please let us know if you run into anything!

[h1]Known (Major) Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*] Frame drops (especially on the River level)
[*] Collectable UI doesn't update on pause screen (River)
[*] Music doesn't sync up in River
[/list]

Thanks so much again for all your support. And please let us know what you think!

tags.bug: [*] Collectable UI doesn't update on pause screen (River)
[*] Music doesn't sync up in River

notes.title: Backer Alpha Launch!
notes.content:
[h1]Helloooooo Backers![/h1] 

Welcome to the initial launch of our closed alpha test! It's been a while since we've put out a new update and couldn't be more excited to hear what you all think of the game so far. This initial (Windows-only, Mac support coming soon!) alpha build contains the first two levels of the game. The game is still in active development so expect rough performance and minor bugs.

[h1]What To Test[/h1] 
EVERYTHING! As this is our first build, we're curious to hear all about your play experience. Questions, ideas, concerns, bugs, etc. Everyone here at Gossamer is eager to incorporate your feedback into the game, so please tell us your thoughts.

[h1]Known (Major) Issues[/h1] 
[list]
    [*]Baaaaaaad performance (probably). Decrease resolution & quality settings for smoother framerates
    [*]Glyph collection progress doesn't save between play sessions
    [*]Unresponsive resolution options (click 2 or 3 times to change)
    [*]Camera JOLTS after Cave -> Mountain City cinematic
    [*]Using controller bumpers in setting screen breaks back button
[/list] 

Please let us know if you run into any bugs/crashes/issues and any info we can use to recreate. In the future we'll release specific patch notes detailing all the changes we've incorporated.

Have fun!
